source.nativeIdEvidence: DescribeFeatureType exposes kad_nomer. An exact OGC PropertyIsEqualTo filter for kad_nomer=21320072529 in district 254 returned exactly one feature. GeoServer feature.id changed across repeated queries; use kad_nomer or geometry hash, not generated feature.id. Global permanence semantics not independently documented.

targetGeometryEvidence: The native-CRS 20 m target-centered national WFS query returned a valid closed 1,955.54 m² MultiPolygon containing the selected point, with native cadastral number 21320072529. A 3×3 neighborhood grid returned 154 unique parcels (190 cell rows); all 154 polygons are valid and all rings closed. Five explicit positive-area overlap pairs were assessed in EPSG:32642: 0.0000136–0.450998 m², with a maximum of 0.074380% of the smaller parcel, using the same projected intersection and parent areas. The two largest are highly elongated slivers (minimum rotated envelope 0.009818×98.479806 m and 0.012098×90.983847 m). Only the target parcel contains the center. City coverage and adapter acceptance remain pending.

Layer metadata lists OBJECTID, NAME, ADDRESS, SHAPE_Length, SHAPE_Area, LAND_AREA (“Площадь отвода”), NAME_ZHK and REGION; it does not expose a cadastral number field. Personal names/address values were not requested.

The viewer’s JS uses egkn:u_view for land snapping and sends district_id viewparams; no unfiltered query is equivalent to the viewer’s request.

coverageAssessment: A verified parcel sample exists at the chosen Astana point and within the sampled 3×3 neighborhood only. The national map has a district-scoped native-CRS WFS layer; this bounded sample does not establish complete citywide delivery. Qualified pending root/adapter acceptance.
blocker: Pending independent adapter acceptance. The sample contains five pairwise positive-area overlap slivers; all exact pairs, intersection areas, minimum oriented-envelope width/lengths, parent parcel areas, and relative percentages are recorded in astana-national-u-view-3x3-requests.json. Do not apply a global geometry repair or tolerance; assess these specific pairs. Citywide completeness and kad_nomer permanence/global uniqueness are unverified.
remainingUncertainty: Whether small overlaps are source precision/geometry artifacts; permanence/global uniqueness of `kad_nomer`; and citywide boundary/coverage/completeness outside the sampled cells.
nextStep: Run and pass the root adapter acceptance for district_id=254, native EPSG:32642, stable kad_nomer lookup, bounded pagination and explicit absence; retain the five pair-specific overlap metrics in QA.
